<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_cmdbgov_app.CMDBGovEngine</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Evaluates governance checks (ownership, data quality, relationships, lifecycle) and builds the scorecard.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CMDBGovEngine</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/**
 * CMDBGovEngine
 * Evaluates CMDB governance checks across four pillars and produces a
 * scorecard plus record-level drill-down.
 *
 *   Pillars: ownership | quality | relationships | lifecycle
 *
 * Every check is read-only. Each check is evaluated per CI class so results
 * can be rolled up by pillar, by class, and overall. A check that cannot run
 * on a class (missing field/table) is reported as "n/a"; a check that throws
 * is reported as "error" and excluded from scoring rather than failing the
 * whole scorecard.
 *
 * Scope: x_cmdbgov_app   Access: This application scope only
 */
var CMDBGovEngine = Class.create();

CMDBGovEngine.PILLARS = [
    { id: 'ownership', name: 'Ownership', weight: 30,
      description: 'Every CI has an accountable owner and an active support group.' },
    { id: 'quality', name: 'Data Quality', weight: 30,
      description: 'Records are complete, current, and free of duplicates.' },
    { id: 'relationships', name: 'Relationships', weight: 20,
      description: 'CIs are connected to the services and dependencies they support.' },
    { id: 'lifecycle', name: 'Lifecycle & Certification', weight: 20,
      description: 'Status fields reflect reality and data is periodically certified.' }
];

CMDBGovEngine.DRILL_FIELDS = [
    'name', 'sys_class_name', 'owned_by', 'support_group', 'managed_by_group',
    'install_status', 'operational_status', 'discovery_source', 'last_discovered', 'sys_updated_on'
];

/** Columns to highlight in the drill-down for each check. */
CMDBGovEngine.FOCUS = {
    missing_owner: ['owned_by'], inactive_owner: ['owned_by'],
    missing_support_group: ['support_group'], inactive_support_group: ['support_group'],
    missing_managed_by_group: ['managed_by_group'],
    stale: ['last_discovered', 'sys_updated_on'], duplicates: ['name'],
    no_discovery_source: ['discovery_source'],
    retired_operational_mismatch: ['install_status', 'operational_status'],
    absent_not_retired: ['install_status'], stuck_in_maintenance: ['install_status', 'sys_updated_on'],
    missing_lifecycle: ['install_status']
};

CMDBGovEngine.prototype = {

    /**
     * @param {CMDBGovDataSource} [dataSource]  injected for testing; created from config otherwise
     * @param {Object} [config]
     */
    initialize: function(dataSource, config) {
        this.cfg = config || new CMDBGovConfig().get();
        this.ds = dataSource || new CMDBGovDataSource(this.cfg);
        this.ctx = {
            ds: this.ds,
            cfg: this.cfg,
            staleDate: this.ds.daysAgo(this.cfg.staleDays),
            now: this.ds.now()
        };
        this.checks = this._defineChecks();
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Check catalogue                                                    */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    _defineChecks: function() {
        var has = function(ctx, table, field) { return ctx.ds.fieldExists(table, field); };
        var and = CMDBGovEngine.and;

        return [
            /* ---------------- Ownership ---------------- */
            {
                id: 'missing_owner', pillar: 'ownership', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'count',
                name: 'Missing owner',
                description: 'CIs with no individual in "Owned by".',
                recommendation: 'Assign an accountable individual. Consider deriving the owner from the support group manager as an interim default.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'owned_by'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'owned_byISEMPTY'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'inactive_owner', pillar: 'ownership', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'count',
                name: 'Owner inactive',
                description: 'CIs owned by a user who is no longer active (left the company or deactivated).',
                recommendation: 'Reassign ownership. Add an offboarding step that transfers CI ownership before a user is deactivated.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'owned_by'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'owned_byISNOTEMPTY^owned_by.active=false'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'missing_support_group', pillar: 'ownership', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'count',
                name: 'Missing support group',
                description: 'CIs with no support group, so incidents cannot be routed automatically.',
                recommendation: 'Populate the support group; this drives incident routing and is a CSDM foundation attribute.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'support_group'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'support_groupISEMPTY'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'inactive_support_group', pillar: 'ownership', weight: 2, severity: 'medium', type: 'count',
                name: 'Support group inactive',
                description: 'CIs assigned to a support group that has been deactivated.',
                recommendation: 'Move CIs to the successor group. Review group deactivations for CI impact before they happen.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'support_group'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'support_groupISNOTEMPTY^support_group.active=false'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'missing_managed_by_group', pillar: 'ownership', weight: 1, severity: 'low', type: 'count',
                name: 'Missing managed-by group',
                description: 'CIs with no group responsible for maintaining the CI data itself.',
                recommendation: 'Set "Managed by group" so Data Manager and certification tasks have a destination.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'managed_by_group'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'managed_by_groupISEMPTY'); }
            },

            /* ---------------- Data quality ---------------- */
            {
                id: 'completeness', pillar: 'quality', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'completeness',
                name: 'Required fields empty',
                description: 'Required attributes (per class, from x_cmdbgov_app.required_fields) that are blank.',
                recommendation: 'Fix at the source: map the attribute in Discovery or the integration feeding the class rather than editing records by hand.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return true; },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope, field) { return and(scope, field + 'ISEMPTY'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'stale', pillar: 'quality', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'count',
                name: 'Stale CIs',
                description: 'Not discovered (or, if never discovered, not updated) within the staleness window.',
                recommendation: 'Check discovery coverage for these CIs. If they no longer exist, retire them through a Data Manager policy.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'sys_updated_on'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) {
                    var d = ctx.staleDate;
                    if (has(ctx, t, 'last_discovered')) {
                        return and(scope, 'last_discoveredISNOTEMPTY^last_discovered<' + d) +
                            '^NQ' + and(scope, 'last_discoveredISEMPTY^sys_updated_on<' + d);
                    }
                    return and(scope, 'sys_updated_on<' + d);
                }
            },
            {
                id: 'duplicates', pillar: 'quality', weight: 2, severity: 'medium', type: 'duplicates',
                name: 'Duplicate names',
                description: 'CIs that share a name with at least one other CI in the same class.',
                recommendation: 'Review identification rules (IRE) for the class, then merge or retire duplicates through de-duplication tasks.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'name'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope, value) {
                    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '')
                        return and(scope, 'nameISNOTEMPTY');
                    return and(scope, 'name=' + String(value).replace(/\^/g, '^^'));
                }
            },
            {
                id: 'no_discovery_source', pillar: 'quality', weight: 1, severity: 'low', type: 'count',
                name: 'Manually maintained',
                description: 'CIs with no discovery source; they depend entirely on people to stay accurate.',
                recommendation: 'Bring these classes under Discovery or an integration where possible; otherwise include them in certification.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'discovery_source'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'discovery_sourceISEMPTY'); }
            },

            /* ---------------- Relationships ---------------- */
            {
                id: 'orphans', pillar: 'relationships', weight: 3, severity: 'high', type: 'count',
                name: 'Orphaned CIs',
                description: 'CIs with no relationships at all, as parent or child.',
                recommendation: 'Map dependencies through Service Mapping or Discovery. Orphans cannot support impact analysis.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return ctx.ds.tableExists('cmdb_rel_ci'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) {
                    return and(scope, 'RLQUERYcmdb_rel_ci.parent,=0^ENDRLQUERY^RLQUERYcmdb_rel_ci.child,=0^ENDRLQUERY');
                }
            },
            {
                id: 'not_in_service', pillar: 'relationships', weight: 2, severity: 'medium', type: 'count',
                name: 'Not part of any service',
                description: 'CIs not associated with any service (svc_ci_assoc), so service impact is unknown.',
                recommendation: 'Associate CIs with application services (CSDM) through Service Mapping, tag-based or dynamic CI groups.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) {
                    return ctx.ds.tableExists('svc_ci_assoc') && t.indexOf('cmdb_ci_service') !== 0;
                },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) {
                    return and(scope, 'RLQUERYsvc_ci_assoc.ci_id,=0^ENDRLQUERY');
                }
            },

            /* ---------------- Lifecycle & certification ---------------- */
            {
                id: 'retired_operational_mismatch', pillar: 'lifecycle', weight: 2, severity: 'medium', type: 'count',
                name: 'Retired but still installed',
                description: 'Operational status is Retired while install status is not Retired.',
                recommendation: 'Align statuses. Add a business rule or Data Manager retirement policy so both fields move together.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'operational_status') && has(ctx, t, 'install_status'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'operational_status=6^install_status!=7'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'absent_not_retired', pillar: 'lifecycle', weight: 2, severity: 'medium', type: 'count',
                name: 'Absent, not retired',
                description: 'Install status is Absent (no longer found by Discovery) but the CI was never retired.',
                recommendation: 'Confirm decommission and retire through a Data Manager retirement policy.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'install_status'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'install_status=100'); }
            },
            {
                id: 'stuck_in_maintenance', pillar: 'lifecycle', weight: 1, severity: 'low', type: 'count',
                name: 'Stuck in maintenance',
                description: 'Install status In Maintenance with no update within the staleness window.',
                recommendation: 'Return to Installed or retire. Close the loop from change management when maintenance ends.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'install_status'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) { return and(scope, 'install_status=3^sys_updated_on<' + ctx.staleDate); }
            },
            {
                id: 'missing_lifecycle', pillar: 'lifecycle', weight: 1, severity: 'low', type: 'count',
                name: 'Lifecycle stage empty',
                description: 'Lifecycle stage not set (falls back to install status on releases without lifecycle stage fields).',
                recommendation: 'Populate the CSDM lifecycle stage and status so reporting and policies can rely on them.',
                applies: function(ctx, t) { return has(ctx, t, 'life_cycle_stage') || has(ctx, t, 'install_status'); },
                build: function(ctx, t, scope) {
                    return has(ctx, t, 'life_cycle_stage') ? and(scope, 'life_cycle_stageISEMPTY') : and(scope, 'install_statusISEMPTY');
                }
            }
        ];
    },

    /** Unscored instance-level metrics shown alongside each pillar. */
    _defineMetrics: function() {
        var ctx = this.ctx;
        var ds = this.ds;
        return [
            { id: 'open_duplicate_tasks', pillar: 'quality', name: 'Open de-duplication tasks',
              description: 'Open IRE duplicate reconciliation tasks waiting for review.',
              table: 'reconcile_duplicate_task',
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('reconcile_duplicate_task', 'active'); },
              query: function() { return 'active=true'; } },

            { id: 'relationship_total', pillar: 'relationships', name: 'Total relationships',
              description: 'Rows in cmdb_rel_ci.',
              table: 'cmdb_rel_ci',
              applies: function() { return ds.tableExists('cmdb_rel_ci'); },
              query: function() { return ''; } },
            { id: 'relationship_to_retired', pillar: 'relationships', name: 'Relationships to retired CIs',
              description: 'Relationships where the parent or child is retired; these distort impact analysis.',
              table: 'cmdb_rel_ci', bad: true,
              applies: function() { return ds.tableExists('cmdb_rel_ci'); },
              query: function() { return 'parent.install_status=7^ORchild.install_status=7'; } },
            { id: 'relationship_no_type', pillar: 'relationships', name: 'Relationships with no type',
              description: 'Relationships missing a relationship type.',
              table: 'cmdb_rel_ci', bad: true,
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('cmdb_rel_ci', 'type'); },
              query: function() { return 'typeISEMPTY'; } },

            { id: 'dm_policies_active', pillar: 'lifecycle', name: 'Active Data Manager policies',
              description: 'Published Data Manager policies (retirement, archive, deletion, attestation, certification).',
              table: 'cmdb_data_management_policy',
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('cmdb_data_management_policy', 'active'); },
              query: function() { return 'active=true'; } },
            { id: 'dm_tasks_open', pillar: 'lifecycle', name: 'Open certification / attestation tasks',
              description: 'Open Data Manager tasks assigned to CI owners and groups.',
              table: 'cmdb_data_management_task',
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('cmdb_data_management_task', 'active'); },
              query: function() { return 'active=true'; } },
            { id: 'dm_tasks_overdue', pillar: 'lifecycle', name: 'Overdue certification / attestation tasks',
              description: 'Open Data Manager tasks past their due date.',
              table: 'cmdb_data_management_task', bad: true,
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('cmdb_data_management_task', 'due_date'); },
              query: function() { return 'active=true^due_dateISNOTEMPTY^due_date<' + ctx.now; } },
            { id: 'legacy_cert_tasks_open', pillar: 'lifecycle', name: 'Open legacy certification tasks',
              description: 'Open tasks from the legacy Data Certification application.',
              table: 'cert_task',
              applies: function() { return ds.fieldExists('cert_task', 'active'); },
              query: function() { return 'active=true'; } }
        ];
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Scorecard                                                          */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    scorecard: function() {
        var started = new Date().getTime();
        var self = this;
        var ds = this.ds;
        var cfg = this.cfg;
        var scope = cfg.scopeQuery;
        var warnings = [];
        if (cfg.requiredError)
            warnings.push(cfg.requiredError);

        // 1. Resolve classes in scope
        var classes = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < cfg.classes.length; i++) {
            var t = cfg.classes[i];
            if (!ds.tableExists(t)) {
                warnings.push('Class "' + t + '" does not exist on this instance and was skipped.');
                continue;
            }
            var total = 0;
            try {
                total = ds.count(t, scope);
            } catch (e) {
                warnings.push('Could not count "' + t + '": ' + CMDBGovEngine.msg(e));
                continue;
            }
            classes.push({ table: t, label: ds.tableLabel(t), total: total });
        }

        // 2. Evaluate checks per class
        var checkResults = [];
        for (var c = 0; c < this.checks.length; c++)
            checkResults.push(this._evaluate(this.checks[c], classes, scope));

        // 3. Metrics
        var metrics = [];
        var metricDefs = this._defineMetrics();
        for (var m = 0; m < metricDefs.length; m++) {
            var md = metricDefs[m];
            var mr = { id: md.id, pillar: md.pillar, name: md.name, description: md.description,
                       table: md.table, bad: !!md.bad, status: 'ok', value: null, query: '', listUrl: '' };
            try {
                if (!md.applies()) {
                    mr.status = 'n/a';
                } else {
                    mr.query = md.query();
                    mr.value = ds.count(md.table, mr.query);
                    mr.listUrl = self._listUrl(md.table, mr.query);
                }
            } catch (e2) {
                mr.status = 'error';
                mr.error = CMDBGovEngine.msg(e2);
            }
            metrics.push(mr);
        }

        // 4. Roll up
        var pillars = [];
        for (var p = 0; p < CMDBGovEngine.PILLARS.length; p++) {
            var pd = CMDBGovEngine.PILLARS[p];
            var pChecks = checkResults.filter(function(r) { return r.pillar === pd.id; });
            pillars.push({
                id: pd.id, name: pd.name, description: pd.description, weight: pd.weight,
                score: CMDBGovEngine.weightedScore(pChecks.map(function(r) {
                    return { weight: r.weight, passRate: r.passRate };
                })),
                checks: pChecks,
                metrics: metrics.filter(function(x) { return x.pillar === pd.id; })
            });
        }

        var overall = CMDBGovEngine.weightedScore(pillars.map(function(pl) {
            return { weight: pl.weight, passRate: pl.score === null ? null : pl.score / 100 };
        }));

        var byClass = classes.map(function(cl) {
            var row = { table: cl.table, label: cl.label, total: cl.total, pillars: {} };
            var pillarParts = [];
            CMDBGovEngine.PILLARS.forEach(function(pd2) {
                var parts = [];
                checkResults.forEach(function(r) {
                    if (r.pillar !== pd2.id) return;
                    var pc = CMDBGovEngine.find(r.perClass, function(x) { return x.table === cl.table; });
                    if (pc && pc.status === 'ok')
                        parts.push({ weight: r.weight, passRate: pc.passRate });
                });
                var s = CMDBGovEngine.weightedScore(parts);
                row.pillars[pd2.id] = s;
                pillarParts.push({ weight: pd2.weight, passRate: s === null ? null : s / 100 });
            });
            row.overall = CMDBGovEngine.weightedScore(pillarParts);
            return row;
        });

        // 5. Top issues: largest weighted failures by check x class
        var issues = [];
        checkResults.forEach(function(r) {
            r.perClass.forEach(function(pc) {
                if (pc.status === 'ok' && pc.failCount > 0) {
                    issues.push({
                        checkId: r.id, name: r.name, pillar: r.pillar, severity: r.severity,
                        table: pc.table, label: pc.label, failCount: pc.failCount, total: pc.total,
                        passRate: pc.passRate, impact: pc.failCount * r.weight, listUrl: pc.listUrl
                    });
                }
            });
        });
        issues.sort(function(a, b) { return b.impact - a.impact; });

        return {
            generatedAt: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue(),
            durationMs: new Date().getTime() - started,
            source: ds.describe(),
            settings: {
                classes: cfg.classes,
                scopeQuery: scope,
                staleDays: cfg.staleDays,
                staleDate: this.ctx.staleDate,
                required: cfg.required,
                dataSource: cfg.dataSource,
                remoteUrl: cfg.remoteUrl,
                authType: cfg.authType,
                authProfile: cfg.authProfile
            },
            warnings: warnings,
            totals: {
                cis: classes.reduce(function(s, x) { return s + x.total; }, 0),
                classes: classes.length
            },
            overall: overall,
            pillars: pillars,
            classes: classes,
            byClass: byClass,
            topIssues: issues.slice(0, 10)
        };
    },

    _evaluate: function(check, classes, scope) {
        var ctx = this.ctx;
        var ds = this.ds;
        var res = {
            id: check.id, pillar: check.pillar, name: check.name, description: check.description,
            recommendation: check.recommendation, severity: check.severity, weight: check.weight,
            type: check.type, status: 'ok', failCount: 0, total: 0, passRate: null,
            perClass: [], details: []
        };
        var ok = 0, errors = 0;

        for (var i = 0; i < classes.length; i++) {
            var cl = classes[i];
            var pc = { table: cl.table, label: cl.label, status: 'ok', failCount: 0, total: 0, passRate: null, listUrl: '' };
            try {
                if (!check.applies(ctx, cl.table)) {
                    pc.status = 'n/a';
                } else if (check.type === 'completeness') {
                    this._evalCompleteness(check, cl, scope, pc, res);
                } else if (check.type === 'duplicates') {
                    this._evalDuplicates(check, cl, scope, pc, res);
                } else {
                    var q = check.build(ctx, cl.table, scope);
                    pc.failCount = cl.total === 0 ? 0 : ds.count(cl.table, q);
                    pc.total = cl.total;
                    pc.listUrl = this._listUrl(cl.table, q);
                }
                if (pc.status === 'ok') {
                    pc.passRate = pc.total > 0 ? Math.max(0, 1 - pc.failCount / pc.total) : null;
                    res.failCount += pc.failCount;
                    res.total += pc.total;
                    ok++;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                pc.status = 'error';
                pc.error = CMDBGovEngine.msg(e);
                errors++;
            }
            res.perClass.push(pc);
        }

        res.passRate = res.total > 0 ? Math.max(0, 1 - res.failCount / res.total) : null;
        if (ok === 0)
            res.status = errors > 0 ? 'error' : 'n/a';
        else if (errors > 0)
            res.status = 'partial';
        if (res.status === 'error' || res.status === 'n/a')
            res.passRate = null;
        if (res.status === 'error') {
            var firstErr = CMDBGovEngine.find(res.perClass, function(x) { return x.status === 'error'; });
            res.error = firstErr ? firstErr.error : 'Check failed';
        }
        return res;
    },

    _requiredFields: function(table) {
        var req = this.cfg.required || {};
        var list = [].concat(req._default || [], req[table] || []);
        var seen = {};
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            var f = String(list[i]).trim();
            if (!f || seen[f]) continue;
            seen[f] = true;
            if (this.ds.fieldExists(table, f))
                out.push(f);
        }
        return out;
    },

    _evalCompleteness: function(check, cl, scope, pc, res) {
        var fields = this._requiredFields(cl.table);
        if (fields.length === 0) {
            pc.status = 'n/a';
            return;
        }
        var empty = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            var q = check.build(this.ctx, cl.table, scope, fields[i]);
            var n = cl.total === 0 ? 0 : this.ds.count(cl.table, q);
            empty += n;
            res.details.push({
                table: cl.table, label: cl.label, field: fields[i], empty: n, total: cl.total,
                populated: cl.total > 0 ? 1 - n / cl.total : null,
                listUrl: this._listUrl(cl.table, q)
            });
        }
        pc.failCount = empty;
        pc.total = cl.total * fields.length;
        pc.fields = fields;
        pc.listUrl = this._listUrl(cl.table, scope);
    },

    _evalDuplicates: function(check, cl, scope, pc, res) {
        var limit = this.cfg.duplicateGroupLimit;
        var groups = cl.total === 0 ? [] : this.ds.groupCount(cl.table, 'name', check.build(this.ctx, cl.table, scope), 2, limit);
        var dupCis = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++)
            dupCis += groups[i].count;
        pc.failCount = dupCis;
        pc.total = cl.total;
        pc.groups = groups.length;
        pc.truncated = groups.length >= limit;
        pc.listUrl = this._listUrl(cl.table, check.build(this.ctx, cl.table, scope));
        for (var j = 0; j < groups.length && j < 25; j++) {
            res.details.push({
                table: cl.table, label: cl.label, value: groups[j].value, count: groups[j].count,
                listUrl: this._listUrl(cl.table, check.build(this.ctx, cl.table, scope, groups[j].value))
            });
        }
    },

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    /*  Drill-down                                                         */
    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    /**
     * Records failing a check for one class.
     * @param {String} checkId
     * @param {String} table
     * @param {String} [arg]  field name (completeness) or name value (duplicates)
     */
    records: function(checkId, table, arg) {
        var check = CMDBGovEngine.find(this.checks, function(c) { return c.id === checkId; });
        if (!check)
            throw new Error('Unknown check: ' + checkId);
        if (this.cfg.classes.indexOf(table) < 0)
            throw new Error('Class "' + table + '" is not in the governed scope.');
        if (!check.applies(this.ctx, table))
            throw new Error('Check "' + check.name + '" does not apply to ' + table + '.');

        var scope = this.cfg.scopeQuery;
        var limit = this.cfg.drilldownLimit;

        if (check.type === 'duplicates' && !arg) {
            var groups = this.ds.groupCount(table, 'name', check.build(this.ctx, table, scope), 2, limit);
            var self = this;
            return {
                kind: 'groups', checkId: checkId, table: table, label: this.ds.tableLabel(table),
                groups: groups.map(function(g) {
                    return { value: g.value, display: g.display, count: g.count,
                             listUrl: self._listUrl(table, check.build(self.ctx, table, scope, g.value)) };
                })
            };
        }

        if (check.type === 'completeness') {
            if (!arg)
                throw new Error('Choose a field to see records missing it.');
            if (this._requiredFields(table).indexOf(arg) < 0)
                throw new Error('Field "' + arg + '" is not a required field for ' + table + '.');
        }

        var q = check.build(this.ctx, table, scope, arg);
        var fields = CMDBGovEngine.DRILL_FIELDS.slice();
        if (check.type === 'completeness' && fields.indexOf(arg) < 0)
            fields.splice(1, 0, arg);
        var rows = this.ds.list(table, q, fields, limit, 'sys_updated_on');
        var base = this.ds.instanceUrl();
        rows.forEach(function(r) {
            r.url = base + table + '.do?sys_id=' + r.sys_id;
        });
        return {
            kind: 'records', checkId: checkId, table: table, label: this.ds.tableLabel(table),
            arg: arg || '', query: q, limit: limit,
            focus: CMDBGovEngine.FOCUS[checkId] || [],
            total: this.ds.count(table, q),
            listUrl: this._listUrl(table, q),
            fields: fields.filter(function(f) {
                return rows.some(function(r) { return r.hasOwnProperty(f); });
            }),
            rows: rows
        };
    },

    _listUrl: function(table, query) {
        return this.ds.instanceUrl() + table + '_list.do?sysparm_query=' + encodeURIComponent(query || '');
    },

    type: 'CMDBGovEngine'
};

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/*  Static helpers                                                         */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

CMDBGovEngine.and = function(a, b) {
    if (!a) return b || '';
    if (!b) return a;
    return a + '^' + b;
};

/** Weighted average of passRates (0..1) -> score 0..100, or null if nothing to score. */
CMDBGovEngine.weightedScore = function(parts) {
    var w = 0, s = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        if (parts[i].passRate === null || parts[i].passRate === undefined) continue;
        w += parts[i].weight;
        s += parts[i].weight * parts[i].passRate;
    }
    return w === 0 ? null : Math.round((s / w) * 1000) / 10;
};

CMDBGovEngine.find = function(arr, fn) {
    for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
        if (fn(arr[i])) return arr[i];
    return null;
};

CMDBGovEngine.msg = function(e) {
    return (e && e.message) ? String(e.message) : String(e);
};
